docs.title: Artificial Neural Networks and Deep Learning
docs.text:
Edition

2026.2 — Insper

Henrique Turco — github.com/henriquetg1

This site is my portfolio for the course Artificial Neural Networks and Deep Learning (Insper, 2026.2). Each exercise lives in its own folder under docs/exercises/, with the report (index.md), the code that was actually run (code/), and the figures shown in the report (figures/).

docs.title: Reproducing
docs.text:
python3 -m venv env
source env/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python docs/exercises/data/code/main.py   # regenerates figures, tables and results.json
mkdocs serve -o                           # preview the site locally
